listing.name: Doritos Crash Course — Doritos Crash Course — Native PC (portingpete)
listing.summary: Experimental Doritos Crash Course port. Upstream reports that all 15 courses load in version 0.1.0; course completion has not been confirmed. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own complete extracted Doritos Crash Course Xbox 360 files, including the encrypted default.xex and data.pak.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the upstream Windows source-build guide with your own encrypted default.xex and data.pak. The first build also requires shader capture.

warnings: Upstream reports that all 15 courses load in experimental version 0.1.0, with brief gameplay observed. Completing those courses has not been confirmed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
